title: Desk bridge v0: agent
description: One registry for every agent and its runs (ADR 0100). agent.list answers the registry (specs/agent/v0) and agent.cancel stops a run, both under perm:manage: they show and stop what agents do with their grants. Runs are items of kind run (specs/item/v0), so data.query and views read them: the core records one for every command an agent caller asks for and for the brain directory's tasks, and a plugin reports the runs of the agents it runs with agent.report. agent.cancelled tells the reporter to stop a run.

AgentListRequest.description: Every agent the desk knows, with its state now.

AgentListResult.description: Result of agent.list: Eris first, then by name.

AgentCancelParams.description: Parameters of agent.cancel: the run's item id, and its source when it is not the core's own (desk.agents).

AgentCancelRequest.description: Stop a run: a waiting one is refused its approval, a running command is answered cancelled to its caller, and a reported run's reporter hears agent.cancelled. An ended run is left as it is.

AgentCancelResult.description: Result of agent.cancel: whether the run was still under way.

AgentReported.description: The agent a reported run belongs to: the reporter's own id for it (claude), its name and what thinks for it. The registry lists it as <reporter>/<id>.

AgentReportParams.description: Parameters of agent.report: one run of an agent the caller runs, as it is now. Report it when it starts and again when it changes or ends; the same id updates it.

AgentReportRequest.description: Report a run of an agent the caller runs (a plugin's local agent programs). It needs no scope: a caller reports only under its own source, { connector: <caller>, instance: default }.

AgentCancelledData.description: Payload of agent.cancelled: the reported run the person asked to stop.

AgentCancelledEvent.description: The person asked to stop a run the caller reported. Sent to that reporter only; it stops the run and reports it cancelled.
